label: SEOUL GUIDE
title: Sheet masks: how Koreans actually use them
dek: A Korean staple that is cheap, quick and everywhere.

points.t: After cleansing and toner, for 10 to 20 minutes.
Leaving a mask on until it dries can pull moisture back out.
Pat in the leftover essence, then apply moisturiser.
Low price, clear promise, and easy to try many brands.
